purpose: Ephemeral single-use high-entropy password-recovery proof for one Account and the exact verified EmailIdentity that received the recovery link; new issuance supersedes the prior current Account challenge.

columns.name: password_recovery_ref
columns.meaning: Public non-secret reference identifying the current recovery challenge.
columns.value_contract: UUIDv7 only; raw recovery bearer is separate.

columns.name: account_ref
columns.meaning: Account whose password may be reset after proof validation.
columns.value_contract: Must be the owner of email_identity_ref through the composite FK.

columns.name: email_identity_ref
columns.meaning: Exact verified recovery/contact email identity that received this proof.
columns.value_contract: Bound together with account_ref to the same EmailIdentity row.

columns.name: secret_verifier
columns.meaning: Domain-separated SHA-256 verifier of the 256-bit raw recovery bearer secret.
columns.value_contract: Exactly 32 bytes; raw secret is never persisted.

primary_key.name: pk_password_recovery_challenge
primary_key.reason: Stable public non-secret reference for proof presentation.

foreign_keys.name: fk_password_recovery_challenge_email_identity_ref_account_ref_email_identity
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind recovery proof to the exact verified email channel and its authoritative owning Account, preventing mismatched Account/email recovery state.

unique_constraints.name: uq_password_recovery_challenge_account_ref
unique_constraints.reason: At most one current recovery challenge per Account; issuance through any eligible email supersedes old state.

unique_constraints.name: uq_password_recovery_challenge_secret_verifier
unique_constraints.reason: Prevent verifier aliasing; collision is a security/RNG anomaly.

check_constraints.name: ck_password_recovery_challenge_chronology
check_constraints.expression_contract: isfinite(issued_at) AND isfinite(expires_at) AND expires_at > issued_at
check_constraints.reason: Keep the recovery proof window finite and ordered.

indexes.name: uq_password_recovery_challenge_secret_verifier
indexes.reason: Verifier uniqueness and indexed proof lookup.

indexes.name: ix_password_recovery_challenge_email_identity_ref
indexes.reason: FK support and exact recovery-channel correlation without scanning challenge state.

indexes.name: ix_password_recovery_challenge_expires_at
indexes.reason: Bounded lazy cleanup of expired recovery state.

state_history.current_binding: Unique account_ref means the table carries only the currently issued recovery proof for an Account; email_identity_ref records exactly which verified channel received it.
state_history.chronology: Current control state only; superseded/consumed proofs are deleted rather than retained as product history.
state_history.immutability_policy: Recovery reference, Account/email binding, verifier and issue/expiry evidence are immutable for one challenge row.

lifecycle.retention: Ephemeral security-control state; 30-minute proof window plus bounded cleanup.
lifecycle.redaction: Raw recovery bearer is forbidden from PostgreSQL/logging; verifier and email binding are security-sensitive metadata.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: Runtime DELETE is required for supersession, single-use consumption and bounded expiry cleanup.

obligations: M4 real PostgreSQL schema, exact Account/email binding, ACL, single-use, supersession and reset-concurrency proof
